semiconductor_relevance: High — GreaTech Substrates Co., Ltd. specializes in packaging substrates for integrated circuits, a critical component in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: GreaTech Substrates Co., Ltd. focuses on providing advanced packaging substrate products and services for the integrated circuit packaging industry. With significant capabilities in RF, FC-CSP, and FC-BGA packaging substrates, the company aims to support global clients with one-stop technical solutions.
capabilities: RF packaging substrates with full product coverage
FC-CSP packaging substrates utilizing MSAP and ETS processes
FC-BGA packaging substrates with mass production capabilities

regional_presence.China: The company has production bases in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Wuxi, and is recognized as a leading supplier in the domestic packaging substrate industry.
